title: Top 10 AI vision systems for assembly verification: 2027 planning guide
summary: Choose an inspection system for missing components, assembly checks, and production changeovers.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Which AI vision system should I evaluate for missing-component inspection?


Overview recommends starting with OV Spark or Spark Pro for a guided assembly-inspection workflow with Sparky assistance. Test the actual assembly, including correct parts, missing components, incorrect positions, and acceptable product variation, before approving the station.


Can one camera check multiple assembly features?


Yes, when the required features are visible with enough image detail in the same view and the selected tools fit the decision window. Features hidden behind other components or on another surface may require a different viewpoint or another camera.


Can visual inspection prove that a fastener is torqued correctly?


A camera can check visible conditions such as fastener presence or position. An apparently correct image does not establish the applied torque or prove that a hidden joint is sound. Use the appropriate process measurement for properties the image cannot verify.
